items.title: 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade moved to Saturday due to projected storm
items.brief: For the first time in its history, the iconic Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed because of forecasted heavy rain and strong winds.

items.title: The government says Iowa detonation results exceeded expectations. Now what?
items.brief: Two hazy plumes rose over the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant Wednesday morning, punctuating days of legal battles and public outcry over the Army’s plan to detonate nearly five tons of deteriorating lead azide.

items.title: Judge blocks Trump’s FCC from targeting ABC stations: ‘This is not a close case’
items.brief: Siding with Disney in a dramatic First Amendment case, a federal judge has barred the Trump administration from taking further action against ABC’s local TV stations.

items.title: At least 31 killed in fuel tanker fire near Cairo, Egyptian authorities say
items.brief: A tanker truck carrying petroleum products crashed in Egypt’s Giza governorate Wednesday, igniting a massive fire that killed at least 31 people and injured 21 others, according to according to Egyptian authorities.

items.title: A man in Boston won $1 million in the lottery. Then ICE arrested him
items.brief: Over the weekend, the Massachusetts Lottery shared a picture of Ariel Velasquez-Morales smiling gently as he gripped an oversized check for $1 million in winnings.

items.title: Andy Taylor, original guitarist for Duran Duran, dies at 65
items.brief: Andy Taylor, an original member of Duran Duran whose distinctive guitar riffs shaped many of the iconic ‘80s new wave band’s biggest hits — including “Rio” and “The Reflex” — has died.

items.title: Full extent of Christa Pike injuries ‘still unknown’ 2 months after her botched execution, her attorney says in legal filing
items.brief: The full extent of Christa Pike’s injuries is “still unknown” two months after her botched execution, her attorney says in a new legal filing in a Nashville, Tennessee court.
